title: Unisender
tagline: Unisender is tool is use to send asset to multiple  addresses use less gas fees and less time.
description: This project is made using the Uniswap interface template. We are adding tools to send money to multiple addresses using Uniswap. By using Unisender you can easily send funds to multiple accounts. It will use fewer gas fees and you do not have to make multiple transactions and lots of gas fees.
how_its_made: Unisender is made using the Uniswap Interface template. Unisender is made using React Js, JavaScript, Typescript, Solidity, etc. This is my idea to send money easily from one account to multiple using fewer gas fees and less time. Uniswap liquidity will use to provide the assets.
